name: KeyFlight PNR Converter
author: KeyFlight
description: Decode Amadeus, Sabre, Galileo and Worldspan PNRs into a readable itinerary and JSON, or make a PRO ticket PDF. Hosted remote server for travel agents; needs a KeyFlight API key.

tools.name: decode_pnr
tools.description: Decode a raw PNR into a readable itinerary (text) and structured JSON: passengers, flights, airports, terminals, times, flight duration, airline locators. Each decode with flights counts towards the monthly limit of the KeyFlight subscription, as in the PNR API.

text.description: The PNR as shown by the GDS (Amadeus, Sabre, Galileo/Apollo, Worldspan), up to 20000 characters.

view.description: Layout of the itinerary text. Default: table.

tools.name: make_ticket
tools.description: Make a PRO e-ticket PDF (Expedia style: PNR, airline logos, class, optional price) from a raw PNR and return a link to the PDF. Passenger names and the PNR code come from the text unless given here. Included in the KeyFlight subscription.

text.description: The PNR as shown by the GDS (Amadeus, Sabre, Galileo/Apollo, Worldspan), up to 20000 characters.

passengers.description: Passenger names as on the ticket, e.g. "SMITH/JOHN MR". Default: the names in the PNR.

pnr.description: Booking code printed on the ticket, 5–8 letters and digits. Default: the one in the text, or a random one.

booking_class.description: Default: the cabin of the first flight's booking class.

price.description: Total price printed on the ticket, e.g. "1200.50". Default: no price on the ticket.

currency.description: Currency next to the price, e.g. "USD", "€". Default: "$".

logo.description: Logo in the ticket header. Default: none.
